name: Light Switch
instruction: Create a 3D model of a light switch. The switch should be rectangular with a toggle in the center.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a light switch.
The switch is rectangular in shape.
The toggle is positioned in the center of the switch.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The toggle is proportionate to the size of the switch.
Texture and surface detail: The surface of the switch should be smooth.
The toggle may have a slightly raised texture for ease of use.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The toggle is correctly centered within the rectangular switch.
The switch has a flat profile suitable for wall mounting.
Object distance and contact: The toggle does not overlap with the edges of the switch.
There is no gap between the toggle and the switch surface.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The model adheres to the instruction of being rectangular with a central toggle.
